mediaPolicy.representation: exact canonical scored ROI source and color-coded GT PNGs
mediaPolicy.roiDimensions: source and GT remain in their original frozen scored ROI pixel coordinates; no resize or resampling
mediaPolicy.timebase: timestampMs is null because the frozen validation manifest does not provide an acquisition FPS/timebase; sourceFrameNumber is retained
mediaPolicy.playback: ordered synchronized frame slideshow; original frame-number gaps are preserved

selectionPolicy.representative: prediction-blind seeds from the frozen source/GT atlas; each clip context is selected by source frame order from the same validation candidate_sequence_id
selectionPolicy.worstCase: separate outcome-selected set; one maximum retained equivalent-diameter ARE frame per canonical method/plane, with selection source and metric value recorded
